The '''Valera system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Valera]].<ref name="Planets" /> At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', which is set before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], establishes that the [[Valera uprising|uprising]] on [[Valera]] took place at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the latter in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the former in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the uprising must have occurred at some point between those two dates.</ref> an [[Valera uprising|uprising]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place on Valera and was quelled by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]''.<ref name="Planets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valera [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
